notes: Companion 1.0.7 fixes a pairing-status race where auth_ok could set the extension to ready and then the older asynchronous secret-storage step could overwrite the display with the stale message secret stored, awaiting auth_ok. Successful pairing now settles on ready. This release includes chat-youtube-companion-1.0.7.zip and retains the optional local LG webOS TV controls from 1.9.12.
